answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, weighted by independent path length, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The relic of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The nectar holds work receipts rather than names, so the violet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
